headline: Executive order sets up a management board for the Internal Revenue Service.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates an Internal Revenue Service Management Board. Such a board would likely advise on or oversee how the IRS is run. No summary was provided, so details about who sits on the board and what powers it has are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Internal Revenue Service leaders and staff
who_it_affects.how: The IRS would gain a management board involved in how the agency is run.
Treasury officials may serve on or work with the new board, since the IRS is part of the Treasury Department.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on June 24, 1997 (not confirmed by the source material)
